name: Sentry MCP
description: Official Sentry remote MCP server — pull issues, traces, and AI root-cause analysis into any coding agent. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and more.

skills.name: Issue Lookup
skills.description: Fetches Sentry issues by URL, ID, or query, returning full error details, stack traces, and event context.

skills.name: Trace Analysis
skills.description: Retrieves distributed traces and span data to identify performance bottlenecks and error propagation paths.

skills.name: Root Cause Analysis
skills.description: Runs Sentry's Seer AI engine on an issue to pinpoint the root cause and surface suggested fixes.
